evidence.observation: Purge brought O2 down from about 28,800 ppm to 12 ppm, and it has stayed at 1.5–5 ppm since then
Overshot to 760.4 °C at the start of growth, then settled at 750 ±0.6 °C
Heater power is steady at about 46% during the hold, rising smoothly with temperature during the ramp
Ar flow matches the setpoint within about 1.5 sccm throughout
Controller status is running and matches the stage changes

args.missing_evidence: No pressure gauge is installed, so an exhaust blockage can't be seen directly. No reference ranges from normal runs were provided, so readings can't be compared against them. No sample characterization is available yet.
